where_to_go: Work Orders → open a work order
expected_result: All money visible. Senior SA has See Financial Data ON.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Senior Service Advisor role has the 'See Financial Data' cross-toggle ON, so every dollar figure on a work order — line Rate/Margin/Total, the Financial Info card, the Stats tab money columns, and the Finance tab invoice — must be visible, nothing hidden or masked. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Senior Service Advisor row #16]
expected_plain: Logged in as a Senior Service Advisor, every price and dollar amount on a work order should be visible.
actual_result_plain: Opened invoiced work order S9-24661 as Tech-with-Senior-Service-Advisor. All money was visible everywhere. The left Financial Info card showed Parts $0.00, Labor $929.72, Shop Supplies $97.62, Subtotal $1,027.34, GST $51.37, Total $1,078.71, Balance $1,078.71. The Lines grid showed the Rate ($232.43), Margin (100%) and Total ($929.72) columns with values. The Stats tab showed Labor/Parts/Total sections with Sell price ($929.72), Cost ($0), Margin ($929.72) and % (100%) figures. The Finance tab rendered the full invoice INV-S9-24661 with Labor $929.72, Parts $0.00, Shop supplies $97.62, Subtotal $1,027.34, GST(5%) $51.37, Total $1,078.71 and Balance $1,078.71. Nothing was hidden or masked.
notes: fe-permissions confirm cross_toggles.seeFinancialData=true and view_mode=full for the Senior Service Advisor role. Money confirmed on Lines, Financial Info card, Stats tab and Finance tab.

what_to_do: Create invoice, then reverse an invoice / delete a payment / void.
expected_result: All allowed. Senior SA has Invoicing and Payments View/Create and Edit/Delete (full).
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319 the Senior Service Advisor role has Invoicing & Payments View, Create/Edit AND Delete all ON, so the role can create invoices, take payments, and reverse/void/delete invoices and payments without restriction. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Senior Service Advisor row #17]
expected_plain: A Senior Service Advisor should be able to create an invoice and also reverse/void an invoice or delete a payment — nothing blocked.
actual_result_plain: Confirmed full invoicing in the Finance tab. On not-yet-invoiced work order S9-24669 (Complete) the Finance tab showed an enabled 'Create Invoice' button. On invoiced work order S9-24661 the invoice actions three-dots menu (next to 'New Payment') showed both 'Reverse' and 'Issue Credit'; a 'New Payment' button was also present for taking payments. On paid work order S9-24656 the Finance tab rendered with Payments $1,348.39 / Balance $0.00 and the same invoice toolbar. No action was greyed out or blocked.
notes: fe-permissions confirm invoicingPaymentsView, invoicingPaymentsCreateAndEdit and invoicingPaymentsDelete all present. Create Invoice seen on non-invoiced WO; Reverse + Issue Credit seen in invoice actions menu on invoiced WO.
